name: Luck Blade
description: A longsword with a four-leafed clover worked into its pommel.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this luck; this one is a longsword. It strikes truer and harder than a plain sword, and while it is on your person every saving throw you make is a little better.

## Luck

Once a day you can reroll one attack roll, ability check or saving throw you dislike, and must keep the new roll.

## Wishes

It holds up to three wishes, 1d4 - 1 when it is found, and never regains them. One can be spent a day.
